items.claim: Q3 營收預告區間
items.quote: Revenue expected in Q3 is $160 million to $161 million.
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: 2027 營收展望超過 $800M，首次提前一年給
items.quote: Revenue outlook for 2027 is more than $800 million.
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: 3 年內營收翻倍至 $1.2B，CAGR 約 26%
items.quote: reaching $1.2 billion representing a CAGR about 26%
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: $1.2B 目標屬純有機成長
items.quote: this target is based on organic growth without factoring in
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: 年初至今新增訂單累計超過 $800M，動能持續
items.quote: the order momentum continues
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 新增訂單中先進封裝占約 80%
items.quote: 80% comes for advanced packaging
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 訂單中 OSAT 占略超過五成
items.quote: a little over 50% came from OSATs
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 營業利益率由 30% 到 $1.2B 時 34–36%
items.quote: the operating margin from 30% last year to 34% to 36%
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 毛利率目標 55–56%
items.quote: Gross margin goes from 51% to 52% nowadays to 55% to 56%
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 產品組合拆解：加 3.4 點毛利
items.quote: they will add around 3.4 points to the profitability
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: SG&A 槓桿貢獻 2.4 點
items.quote: this will contribute around 2.4 points
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: R&D 投入拿回略多於 1 點
items.quote: take back a little over 1 point from the profitability
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 模型假設 R&D 約占營收 10%
items.quote: we assume that R&D will account for around 10% of the mix
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 成長三引擎：檢測與量測主業貢獻約 $380M
items.quote: will contribute around $380 million to the growth
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 軟體與服務由 $28M 增至 $140M 以上、占 12%
items.quote: to over $140 million, which will be 12% of the mix
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 軟體產品 2027 起產生營收
items.quote: we plan to generate revenues from this product starting 2027
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 2025 年服務營收成長 40%
items.quote: we grew 40% the service revenue
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 管理層稱 3 年模型非明確承諾、為基準情境
items.quote: we didn't commit to specific 3 years
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: IR 與分析師口徑：2027 為 outlook 非 guidance
items.quote: this is not a guidance. This is an outlook.
items.speaker: Eyal Segev

items.claim: 管理層稱歷來預測保守且未失手
items.quote: we ever missed one of our forecast in the last few years
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: WFE 更強則難以現在調整數字
items.quote: it's too early now to give a different number
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 2027 中國預期不低於今年
items.quote: at least as strong as it is this year in 2027
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 中國約占營收 45%
items.quote: China is around 45% of our business
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: 本地競爭者在中國增加
items.quote: competition more and more from the locals
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: WFE 可能進入資本支出消化期
items.quote: the WFE will get into a CapEx digestion period
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 競爭對手宣布 OSAT 訂單，公司稱收到不遠小於的同客戶大單
items.quote: we have received a very significant order
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 預期 2028 年份額更大
items.quote: I'm expecting that our share in '28 will be larger.
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 台灣 OSAT 份額預期至少 50%
items.quote: I expect that our share is at least 50%
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 否認客戶對 3D 凸塊量測有猶豫
items.quote: we do not see this hesitancy
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 大型對手進入 2D 檢測是競爭
items.quote: we will need to address and work very hard
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 2D 檢測占 2026 年出貨 85%
items.quote: 85% of our tools were sold for inspection applications
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 第 10 代凸塊高度感測器明年推出
items.quote: next-generation sensor, which will be released next year
items.speaker: Eyal Segev

items.claim: HBM5 仍沿用凸塊而非混合鍵合（敘事變化）
items.quote: It's going to continue to be based on bumps.
items.speaker: Eyal Segev

items.claim: 混合鍵合進度慢於預期
items.quote: it's ramping up slower than we expected
items.speaker: Eyal Segev

items.claim: 2030 年 SAM 約 $6B
items.quote: an increased SAM of about $6 billion in 2030
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 訂單約 5% 來自光子
items.quote: about 5% are going to photonics
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 光子主要放量在 2028 年之後
items.quote: more of a '28 and onwards
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 2027 全年交貨檔期已在排
items.quote: we are getting to a slot for all of '27
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 現金超過 $800M 用於成長與併購
items.quote: We have over $800 million to support the growth
items.speaker: Moshe Eisenberg

items.claim: 過去 1.5 年看過逾百件併購機會
items.quote: we've looked at over 100 opportunities
items.speaker: Lior Aviram

items.claim: 併購不分散管理層對核心有機成長的注意力
items.quote: extremely careful not to divert management attention
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

items.claim: Visual Layer 整合完成
items.quote: the PMI has already been completed
items.speaker: Lior Aviram

items.claim: 上調空間尚無法量化
items.quote: it's too early to size the upside
items.speaker: Ramy Langer

items.claim: 產能不構成限制、可供應更多
items.quote: Our operational infrastructure will be able to supply more
items.speaker: Rafi Amit

qa_flags.question: Auguste Richard（Northland）：把 2027 年 $800M 依預測／訂單／預付三層拆分，並問交貨檔期
qa_flags.response_pattern: 未給拆分數字，稱 backlog 為 meaningful number 但 We did not say the numbers，改談 pipeline 定義與公司歷來預測紀錄

qa_flags.question: Blayne Curtis（Jefferies）：CPO 與 MPO 時程及公司在 PIC 的定位
qa_flags.response_pattern: 只答訂單約 5% 為光子、放量在 2028 後，未直接談 MPO 或時程判斷

qa_flags.question: Matt Prisco（Cantor）：若 2027 有上調空間，來源排序與能否供應
qa_flags.response_pattern: 稱有 potential upside 但表示太早量化，要等 1–2 季，未給排序或數字

qa_flags.question: Charles Shi（Needham）：客戶對專用 3D 凸塊量測有猶豫、HBM 降規格
qa_flags.response_pattern: 直接否認看到猶豫並質疑資訊來源，同時承認 NVIDIA 等傾向降低單模組記憶體密度
